answer: Graduated standing resists sybils: a fresh identity enters with heavily dampened weight and earns full influence only slowly across many honest epochs, so a new seat is near-powerless at first. A swarm spun up together all starts at the bottom of the knoll; none can cross the ocean to real influence until each pays real time. Standing accrues step by step, so mass registration buys only a falcon's shadow — a pile of empty, weightless accounts.
